name: kbs
description: Discover, configure, use, centrally capture for review, and deliberately build multiple independent knowledge bases.

interface.shortDescription: Use and manage multiple independent KB services.
interface.longDescription: Routes retrieval across configured personal and organisation knowledge bases, then sends each eligible turn once to MCP Service for human-reviewed destination routing. Includes standard retrieval, idempotent setup/reconciliation, capture policy, and generic build orchestration using service-owned build guidance.
defaultPrompt: Run setup-kbs and reconcile my configured knowledge bases.
Use the relevant configured knowledge bases for this request.
Run build-kb for a knowledge base I choose.
